The image focuses on the head and upper torso, displaying the characteristic glossy black skin with large, irregular yellow patches. The texture appears wet and glandular. One eye is visible, appearing dark and protruding. A portion of a forelimb is visible in the lower left, showing black skin with yellow markings. The background is out-of-focus earthy tones.
